name: js_null_user_profile
prompt:
Fix the JavaScript null user profile bug.

Requirements:
- Modify profile.js only.
- getDisplayName must return the trimmed profile name when user.profile.name is present.
- getDisplayName must return "Guest" when user is null or undefined.
- getDisplayName must return "Guest" when profile is missing.
- getDisplayName must return "Guest" when name is missing or blank.
- Do not modify main.js.
- Do not create new files.
- Use patch_candidate if only getDisplayName changes.
- target_snippet must be copied verbatim from the actual file.

Validation command: node main.js
